faqs.question: What is the Tourism Permission service?
faqs.answer: The Tourism Permission service is a single-window online digital facility operated by the Tourism & Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim. It allows citizens, tour operators, expedition organizers, event managers, and commercial entities to apply for and obtain official government permissions for tourism-related activities across Sikkim.

faqs.question: Who needs to apply for tourism permission in Sikkim?
faqs.answer: Any individual, organization, expedition team, event organizer, or drone operator proposing to conduct trekking expeditions, fairs, rallies, marathons, drone operations, or commercial adventure tourism activities within the jurisdiction of Sikkim must obtain statutory permission from the department prior to commencement.

faqs.question: What are the applicable fees for tourism permissions?
faqs.answer: Under current departmental notifications: Trekking is ₹100, Expedition is ₹100, while permissions for Events/Fairs/Melas/Rallies/Marathons, Drone operations, Adventure Activities, and Any Other categories are currently Free of statutory fee. Online payment for fee-applicable categories can be made digitally via integrated government gateways.

faqs.question: Which documents are required for applying?
faqs.answer: Required documents depend on the specific activity category. Common permissions may require Fire NOC, Environment NOC, Land NOC, or other activity-specific supporting documents. Detailed mandatory document checklists for each activity will be officially confirmed and published by the department.

faqs.question: How long does it take to process a permission application?
faqs.answer: Processing timelines are subject to departmental verification and inter-agency coordination (such as Forest, Police, or District Administration clearances where applicable). Official SLA delivery timelines are currently pending final confirmation by the department.

faqs.question: How will I receive my approved permission?
faqs.answer: Once scrutinized and approved by the designated departmental officer, your official Tourism Permission Certificate will be issued digitally. Applicants can download the signed permission letter directly from their citizen dashboard anytime.

faqs.question: How can the authenticity of the digital permission certificate be verified?
faqs.answer: Every approved digital permission certificate features an official QR code and unique reference ID. Law enforcement officers, checkpoint authorities, and forest staff can scan the QR code using any smartphone camera to instantly verify certificate validity on the official Government of Sikkim portal.
